what: On hover the button pulls back slightly once and then overshoots as if overflowing (cubic-bezier(.68,-.6,.32,2)), growing to 1.05x in .4s with a faint shadow laid down, and the arrow inside moves 6px forward. On release it pulls back and returns on the same curve — applies to round buttons, round icon buttons and card photos (look: media — only the image scales 1.04x, no shadow)

options.--fx-scale: Scale-up ratio, default 1.05 — round bottom button (back to top) 1.08
options.look: media: Leaves the element itself untouched and [data-fx-part=Only media] (card photo slot) uses --fx-scale (default 1.04) — no shadow
options.[data-fx-part=arrow]: (If present) arrow pushed forward along the same curve

use: In detail · PhotoText

from.where: shared.css .kg-btn (round button 1.05 · arrow 6px) · .kg-round (News row left/right buttons 1.05) · .kg-top (back to top 1.08) · .kg-post photo cell (look: media 1.04)
